tools.name: base_tx_explain
tools.description: Explain a Base mainnet transaction: status, fee, decoded method + args (openchain signature DB), and ERC-20 transfers with symbols and human amounts. Costs $0.01.

tools.name: base_token_approvals
tools.description: Check a Base wallet's ERC-20 approvals: allowances for 8 major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, AERO...) to 8 common spenders (Permit2, Uniswap, Aerodrome, 1inch, 0x, LI.FI, Odos); flags unlimited approvals. Costs $0.005.

tools.name: base_address_inspect
tools.description: Inspect any Base address: EOA vs contract vs EIP-7702 delegated, ETH balance, nonce, EIP-1967/EIP-1167 proxy implementation, and ERC-20 name/symbol/decimals/supply. Costs $0.005.
